## Wave 1 Summary

This wave resolves the mack survey's through-line: the framework has a zero-free-parameter dark-matter **mass** anchor (LEGGETT-MOMENT, PROVEN S70 — `D_K` eigenvalue floor onto the Δ_BCS scale) but NOT a zero-free-parameter dark-matter **abundance** (the Leggett channel saturates only ~21–25% of cold DM; the dimer-Z₂ closure already exists as a gate but its 0.27 fraction is asserted-by-construction, not formation-channel-derived), and its one structural dark-energy departure (`w_0 = −0.918 > −1`) is simultaneously a DESI-liability (`w_a` 3.43σ) and a possible S_8-asset (low late-growth → toward KiDS). Four gates: (1) **INV8-W1-1** [compute] computes a primordial-black-hole mass spectrum from the van Hove fold transit (first-order transition + the S64/S38 transit Bogoliubov spectrum + 59.8 Parker pairs + Mach 13.75) and tests whether `f_PBH(M)` integrates to the missing ~0.27 of Ω_DM in the [10¹⁷,10²³] g asteroid window — closing the f_DM abundance gap (G1) AND opening the first compact-object sector (G4); (2) **INV8-W1-2** [compute] computes `S_8 = σ_8√(Ω_m/0.3)` and `τ_reio` from ONE GGE growth history and places `w_0 = −0.918` on BOTH the DESI-liability and the S_8/τ_reio-asset ledgers; (3) **INV8-W1-3** [solo] reconciles the ≥4 register f_DM numbers into ONE substrate-IS partition and states supply-or-retire logic for the dimer-Z₂ Parker channel CONDITIONAL on W1-1; (4) **INV8-W1-4** [compute, spectral-geometer exec, mack-origin] proves the finite-L-cannot-reach-the-analytic-continuation-pole NO-GO theorem characterizing which truncation families miss which poles `s < d/2` and from which side. Gate-type mix: compute × 3, solo × 1. No review/workshop gates in this wave.

- **INV8-W1-1, INV8-W1-2, INV8-W1-4** have NO intra-wave prerequisites — all three consume only canonical constants + the on-disk transit/spectral caches + (for W1-1/W1-2) external observational anchors. They are independently dispatchable in one parallel batch.
- **INV8-W1-3** (solo) has ONE intra-wave CONDITIONAL prerequisite: its supply-or-retire branch for the dimer-Z₂ channel consumes the **INV8-W1-1** verdict line (`f_PBH_integral` value + PASS/FAIL/INFO). If INV8-W1-1's verdict is not yet present in `computations/investigation-8/inv8_gate_verdicts.txt` at W1-3 dispatch, W1-3 still runs — it emits the partition reconciliation unconditionally (the bookkeeping core does NOT depend on W1-1) and closes the dimer supply-or-retire sub-clause as **INFO** (`value='dimer_supply_or_retire_PENDING_W1-1'`) per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` (the CONDITIONAL-gate trigger-first discipline: fire→compute / absent→CONDITIONAL-SKIP-as-INFO). - **Cross-track (NOT a prerequisite, a routing note)**: any `falsifier-master-inventory.md` row or `canonical_constants.py` pin arising from these gates (the PBH `f_PBH(M)`, the S_8/τ_reio σ-distances, the reconciled f_DM partition, the `w0_FW` gate, the §VII.CB re-class) is **session-promotion + `mack-cosmic-bridge` sole-writer**, NOT an investigation-track edit (`gate-verdicts.md §"Investigation-Track Canonical Path"` track-local boundary). # ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  PASS = the fold-transit PBH spectrum integrates to 0.27 +/- 0.05 over [10^17,10^23] g WITHOUT
  exceeding f_PBH = 1 anywhere in the window. Solution-space consequence: the framework's
  DM-abundance gap (G1) CLOSES through a formation-channel PBH spectrum rather than an asserted
  dimer condensate; the dimer-Z2 channel (DIMER-Z2-PAIR-PRODUCTION-75) becomes a redundant
  alternative that can be retired; AND the framework gains its first compact-object sector (G4) —
  a fold-transit PBH mass FUNCTION is the formation-channel Row #88 records as absent.
FAIL_meaning: >
  FAIL = I_PBH lands outside [0.22, 0.32] OR f_PBH > 1 somewhere in the window. Two sub-corridors:
  (a) UNDER-SUPPLY (I_PBH << 0.27) -> PBHs do NOT close the abundance; the dimer-Z2 channel must
  be independently derived (U3 stays open) — the abundance gap is NOT formation-channel-closable.
  (b) OVER-PRODUCTION (f_PBH > 1 in-window) -> the fold produces TOO many PBHs; the supersonic
  transit is constrained by the Carr-KSY asteroid-window envelope, which is itself a NEW falsifier
  surface (the framework's cosmogenesis would over-close the DM budget). Either sub-corridor is
  informative: it maps where on the (sigma_fold, M_H) plane the fold transit sits.
INFO_meaning: >
  INFO = the integral is sensitive to the delta_c band [0.4,0.7] or sits at the window edge such
  that the PASS/FAIL verdict flips within the systematic band. Maps the boundary between the
  supply and no-supply corridors; the next gate pins delta_c from substrate physics (the fold's
  actual critical overdensity) rather than scanning it.

## Wave 1 → Wave 2 Decision Point

Wave 2 (einstein-theorist: the dimensionful-scale knot, precision-GR, quantum foundations) does NOT consume any Wave 1 verdict — the two waves are independent and dispatchable in the same batch. The only cross-wave couplings are at `/rclab-investigate --investigation 8` close, not at plan-time:

- **INV8-W1-1 (PBH abundance) ↔ Wave-2/3 dark-sector mechanisms**: W1-1's `f_PBH` integral and W1-2's `w_0` dual-ledger are the OBSERVE side of the dark-sector front; INV8-W3-1 (Kibble-Zurek walls) and INV8-W2-4 (running-vacuum) are the two competing MECHANISMS for the `w_a` tension. Their convergence (does a wall network OR an RG `c_1 H^2` explain the same `w_a` that W1-2 places on the liability ledger?) is the close-synthesis job, NOT a plan-time gate.
- **INV8-W1-4 (finite-L no-go) ↔ INV8-W3-3 (P(σ) at L_max=14-16)**: both are L_max-truncation gates ("what a finite truncation can/cannot reach in a spectral sum"). W1-4 characterizes the UNREACHABLE residue-subtracted-pole class; W3-3 pushes a DIFFERENT spectral observable (the heat-trace spectral dimension `d_s(σ)`) to higher L_max. COMPLEMENTARY, distinct observable — the close-synthesis checks whether W3-3's `d_s` convergence behavior is consistent with W1-4's reachable/unreachable dichotomy (a spectral dimension is a Weyl-leading quantity, expected REACHABLE; a residue-subtracted finite part is not).

**Within-Wave-1 branching** (the one intra-wave coupling):
